approver: Sergey Bershadsky (owner, 2026-11-03: "modalities set, drop has_pictures (schema 2)", then the widened list)
scope: test_board_cases_route.py: the _admit helper (its refuse_blind_candidate call maps needs_pictures True/False to needs=frozenset({"image"})/frozenset(); its callers test_a_picture_board_refuses_a_blind_model_by_name, test_a_picture_board_admits_a_seeing_model, test_a_text_board_never_reads_the_model_list and test_a_picture_board_with_no_model_in_the_candidate_reads_no_model_list are unchanged), test_without_a_bound_run_nothing_is_checked (needs_pictures=True -> needs=frozenset({"image"})), and test_admission_takes_the_boards_flag (the spy takes needs and records "image" in needs; the _Flagged fake's has_pictures() becomes modalities() returning {"image"} or the empty set). test_board_store.py: test_board_json_records_count_pictures_and_cases_size (the exact dict moves to the v2 shape with "modalities": ["image"] after cases_bytes, and the text board asserts modalities == [] instead of has_pictures is False), test_head_equals_the_legacy_slice ("image" not in modalities()), test_a_picture_board_says_so_without_reading_the_rows ("image" in modalities()), test_legacy_store_serves_the_same_rows_and_scans_for_pictures (("image" in modalities()) is cases_need_pictures(rows) is True). Every other line of both files is unchanged; test_a_broken_board_json_is_refused is deliberately left unedited, and new tests go in the new file test_board_modalities.py.
reason: Owner decision (Sergey, 2026-11-03) for the #1629/#1645 merge: board.json moves to schema screamingface.board.v2 with a sorted modalities list in place of has_pictures, because a picture flag cannot carry the PDF admission decision. BoardStore.has_pictures() is replaced by modalities() and refuse_blind_candidate(node, *, needs_pictures) by refuse_blind_candidate(node, *, needs: frozenset[str]), with no compatibility shims. These OME-1790 tests spelled the removed names; each edit is the mechanical rename (needs_pictures True/False -> {"image"}/empty set, has_pictures() -> "image" in modalities()) and each test keeps its intent: the board flag reaches admission, a picture board refuses a blind model and admits a seeing one, a text board never reads the model list.
